what: Coordinator rule (principles.md; common.md "controlled mechanically"): big types in hot crates do not derive Clone. 7 types in blaze-lazy and blaze-stencil derive Clone and own heap data: crates/blaze-stencil/src/lib.rs:97 struct Error; crates/blaze-stencil/src/tier/runner.rs:35 struct Failure; crates/blaze-stencil/src/tier/runner.rs:43 struct Closed; crates/blaze-lazy/src/runner.rs:203 struct Closed; crates/blaze-lazy/src/plan.rs:79 struct Plan; crates/blaze-lazy/src/stub.rs:158 struct Stubs; crates/blaze-lazy/src/mode.rs:23 enum Refused. For each: no Clone use -> drop it from the derive; a hot use (per function, per stub, per run) -> borrow, share an ID or move, then drop it; cold only (error, setup, tests) -> keep with `// clone: <why>` on the derive line. Same rule speed applied to the done lanes (00946-00948 for db, codegen, diagnostics). Scanner: /tmp/speed-bigclone.py (source text only).

history.note: Dropped Clone from blaze-lazy Plan (plan.rs) and Stubs (stub.rs): nothing clones them. Kept it with a // clone: line on the cold ones: stencil Error (lib.rs), tier Failure and Closed (tier/runner.rs), lazy Closed (runner.rs), Refused (mode.rs; inside SessionError, which derives Clone).
